resale_co.name: Resale Certificate (Maintenance Code certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Mullica Township Zoning and Code Enforcement Office (Code Officer)
resale_co.lead_time: The Township code says the certificate is granted or denied within 10 days of the application.
requirements: Township inspection; the certificate is marked passed or failed (inspection checklist not published)
Certificate shows the building and premises comply with all Township ordinances (Chapter 177 Property Maintenance, Section 177-12)
Copy of approved well and septic testing submitted with the application
Copy of the elevation certificate if the home is in a flood zone

A conditional certificate is possible if the buyer acknowledges the violations noted by the Code Officer and agrees to fix them within 90 days of the sale (extensions of 90 more days if work is in progress)

fees.label: Certificate issued on another reliable agency's preoccupancy inspection (Township code)
fees.quote: In such cases, the certificate shall be issued upon presentation of pertinent documents and payment of the application fee of $25.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Resale Certificate Application from the Township Forms page ('RESALE APPLICATION'). Fill in block, lot, zone, property address, lock box number and location, homeowner, buyer and realtor details, and return it with the $75.00 fee (cash or check), a copy of approved well and septic testing and, in a flood zone, the elevation certificate. The form does not say whether to mail, email or drop it off, so ask the office (609-561-7070 x 133, zoning@mullicatownship.org). The Township then schedules the inspection. Office hours are Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, 8:30 am to 4 pm; an appointment is recommended. The certificate is granted or denied within 10 days of the application.

evidence.quote: THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION WILL BE NEEDED TO PROCESS THE RESALE CERTIFICATE
1. COPY OF APPROVED WELL & SEPTIC TESTING
2. COPY OF ELEVATION CERTIFICATE IN FLOOD ZONE
Zoning Officer · Code Enforcement Official Steven Hadley Email: Zoning@mullicatownship.org Phone: (609) 561-7070 ext. 133
Office hours Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM
Appointments are recommended to ensure the Zoning and Code Officer is available.
No owner or his agent shall sell, rent, transfer, grant, lease, let, mortgage with right of occupancy or otherwise dispose of the ownership or occupancy
evidence.doc_date: Chapter 177 Property Maintenance, Section 177-12 Maintenance Code certificate (read in full 2026-10-13)

evidence.quote: unless a Maintenance Code certificate, certifying that the building and premises are in compliance with all other ordinances of the Township of Mullica, shall first be obtained from the Code Officer of the Township.
Such Maintenance Code certificate shall be granted or denied within 10 days from the date of the application for the same.

A property owner shall be entitled to the issuance of a conditional Maintenance Code certificate, provided that the purchaser of the property acknowledges the violations noted by the Code Officer and agrees that such violations shall be remedied within 90 days of the sale of the property.

resale_co.notes: Re-checked 2026-10-13. The Code Enforcement & Zoning page was redesigned on 2026-10-12, which is why last week's quotes no longer matched; the facts are the same: Steven Hadley, Zoning Officer and Code Enforcement Official, Zoning@mullicatownship.org (the mail link now matches the text), (609) 561-7070 ext. 133, office hours Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM, appointments recommended. The page links to the Township Forms page for zoning, rental and resale forms. The Forms page still posts the same 'Resale Application' (one-page scan dated March 4, 2026) with homeowner, buyer and realtor fields, a lock box line, a $75.00 fee and a passed/failed inspection box. New this check: the full text of Township code Chapter 177, Section 177-12 'Maintenance Code certificate' was read on ecode360 (print view). It bars selling or transferring any dwelling unit without a Maintenance Code certificate from the Code Officer, says the certificate is granted or denied within 10 days, sets a nonrefundable $75 inspection charge (amended 1987, matching the form), a $25 fee when another reliable agency's preoccupancy inspection is accepted, and allows a conditional certificate if the buyer agrees to fix violations within 90 days of the sale. Chapter 177 Article on lead-based paint (Section 177-43) applies to rental units only. A separate $75.00 rental application is for rentals only. Since February 9, 2026 the Uniform Construction Code in Mullica is enforced by the NJ DCA Southern Regional Office, not a Township construction office.

requirements: State certificate of smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm compliance from NJ DCA (state-enforced town)
Smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms as required by N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19; the portable fire extinguisher was dropped from the sale certificate by P.L.2025, c.19

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.area_served: Entire township (Elwood, Nesco, Sweetwater and Weekstown fire companies)
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before the change of occupant for the lowest fee

fees.label: Request received more than 10 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received more than 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $45.00

fees.label: Request received 4 to 10 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $90.00

fees.label: Request received fewer than 4 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant: $161.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety service portal ('Start Your Smoke Certification Application'), choosing change of ownership, the closing date and the property location, and pay online. For questions call the Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement at (609) 633-6106.
authorities.contact_title: Bureau Chief, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (listed as the Fire Official in the state fire directory)

evidence.quote: LEAID: 0117-999 Mullica Twp SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: NJ Division Fire Safety

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Mullica as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates); the state fire directory lists 'NJ Division Fire Safety' for smoke detector compliance in Mullica. Fees are the state fees in N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d), cited from the NJ Register adoption (R.2018 d.074): $45.00, $90.00 and $161.00 by how many business days before the change of occupant the request arrives. No Township page about smoke certificates was found. The directory gives (609) 633-6132 for Louis Kilmer; the Bureau's own page gives (609) 633-6106, which is used here.

other_items.label: Well and septic test results
other_items.detail: A copy of approved well and septic testing is needed to process the resale certificate.

other_items.label: Flood zone elevation certificate
other_items.detail: A copy of the elevation certificate is needed if the home is in a flood zone.

other_items.label: Construction permits
other_items.detail: Since February 9, 2026 the Uniform Construction Code in Mullica is enforced by the NJ DCA Southern Regional Office (DCA SRO contact 609 567-3653), so open construction permits are handled there.

open_questions: How long the resale certificate stays valid is not stated.
What the resale inspection checks is not published.
Is there a reinspection fee after a failed resale inspection? None is published.
